item.title: CM tables J&K Jan Vishwas Ordinance, 2025
item.description: STATE TIMES NEWS JAMMU: Chief Minister Omar Abdullah on Tuesday tabled The Jammu and Kashmir Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Ordinance, 2025 (Ordinance No. 01 of 2025) in the Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly.The Ordinance proposes amendments to certain laws. It seeks to decriminalise a range of minor offences and rationalisation across several sectors.
